author: HardRChoom
quote: Giving a low score just to spite the Rockstar glazers. This 1 point is for Mandy, the female NPC who’s been making the rounds on social media. Rockstar, if you let me abandon Lucia so I can crack Mandy I’ll think about adding another point.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Hands down the best Doom title. The movement tech in this game gives you a level of combat agency that makes you feel like a professional sweat. The game makes you switch weapons as encounters get more complex, and I like that as it allows your entire arsenal to be utilized. You may see that other people bring up the Marauder and say how it’s the one enemy that either is difficult or annoying to fight against. Don’t fret too much. No skill issue, no problem.

author: HardRChoom
quote: I did not really play the other entries of this series, so I had no level of expectation playing through this one. DI2 can be fun, just lobotomize yourself beforehand and then do it again once you finish the game.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Ah yes, the better Bloodborne with a little bit of Sekiro sprinkled in. The weapons system works much better than BB and various Legion arms are about on par with Sekiro’s prosthetic tools. In the DLC, Overture, it introduced both a Gunblade weapon and a Legion arm that’s essentially Doomguy’s super shotgun. It doesn’t get anymore peak than that.

author: HardRChoom
quote: The sense of discovery when playing this game for the first time was a feeling that not many games can achieve. However, going out of your way to discover every dungeon you will find that the number of reused bosses and even regular enemies with a name attached to them therefore making them into a boss, is just outright egregious. This is just Dark Souls 4 with open world elements.

author: HardRChoom
quote: RE3make was not made with same love and care as RE2 and RE4 remakes. They really turned Nemesis into a total buffoon with negative aura. Worry less about S.T.A.R.S and worry more about that botched nose job, Nemmy.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Two of Platinum’s greatest early hits in one package. The first Bayonetta game has always been the toughest to master with its combat system but that just makes it the best of the trilogy. And Vanquish is high octane shooter action from start to finish. If these games are too difficult for you to learn and get good at, set an appointment with your neurologist.

author: HardRChoom
quote: It was cool to see Unc Leon go all action hero mode to save the new young blonde from around the block, Grace Ashcroft. But it’s not all bang-bang shoot, Grace’s more true to horror sections really got me soiling my pants a few times.. or maybe that was the Taco Bell with their C grade meat.

author: HardRChoom
quote: A brand new IP from an established powerhouse in the gaming industry. Capcom took a risk with this game’s design philosophy and it paid off big! The hack and shoot hybrid combat loop is satisfying in every encounter and it does not overstay its welcome. There will be people who say the combat is mindless. Don’t listen to them. They probably played with auto hack ability because they are unskilled plebs.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Palworld completely mogs Pokémon. It’s not even a fair competition. I mean come on, you got pals wielding rocket launchers and miniguns, you can make them slave away day and night for ore and materials, and you can even sleep on same bed as Sekhmet! Gamefreak should just give  Pocketpair the Pokémon IP. I want to see the possibilities with their version of Vaporeon.

author: HardRChoom
quote: That opening sequence with the Mongol invasion was just *chef’s kiss*. The combat has been described as a rock-paper-scissor type of system, but it’s in the form of different sword stances. I think it’s pretty good with how it works. Much better than Ghost of Woketei.

author: HardRChoom
quote: As a trophy hunter, this game was practically unplayable very early on as the platinum trophy was bugged. But after the hotfixes and playing through the game a second time, it’s an okay shooter. The 6 score is for the copium that one day the devs will release the 6 hour cutscene with the ballet twins.

author: HardRChoom
quote: This is Kratos at his best before he became Dad of War beginning in 2018. Combat is ruthless and pure rage incarnate. And don’t forget the air juggles. This is the Kratos I remember!

author: HardRChoom
quote: Honestly, I only got this game because my gooner radar went off when I saw the female character, Gal. Jiggle physics in retro pixels is an art form in itself. Don’t get it twisted though. The combo system in this game is deep and very satisfying to pull off, especially on higher difficulties.

author: HardRChoom
quote: This game was my introduction into the genre known as souls games. Just seent it on PS Plus Catalog and thought to myself, “sure why not?” I was told that I truly haven’t beaten this game yet because I have not fought Orphan of Kos. Well let me tell you something

author: HardRChoom
quote: Playing this game is like interacting with a Saturday morning cartoon. Partly serious with some story beats, but mostly whacky which for this franchise is pretty standard. What sets Infinite Wealth apart is the new locale, Hawaii. And yes, it is also true that only I can fix Chitose Fujinomiya.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Absolutely perfect! This game single handedly destroyed my NNN challenge. This was peak Sony but now they too sanitized. We used to be a proper country.

author: HardRChoom
quote: The female cast does the bursting and I do the busting. Only gets a 9 because it’s not enough burst.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Code Violet is shovelware through and through. Made for a very easy platinum trophy so there’s that. It gets a 2, one for each of the protagonist’s butt cheeks.

author: HardRChoom
quote: When I finished this game for the first time I legit was having a crisis. Didn’t know what to do with my life. Lost a point because it only took place in Midgar and another point for nerfing Tifa with a sports bra.

author: HardRChoom
quote: I have a hard on for the cyberpunk aesthetics.  I find myself going back into Night City over and over again and never getting tired of living and breathing this world. Add on Phantom Liberty and you got yourself a dystopian masterpiece! But what of its original launch you might be asking. It was a buggy and glitchy mess. That’s okay, God forgives all past transgressions.

author: HardRChoom
quote: The gameplay loop in this game is so good and addicting that it made me quit drinking cold turkey. My hands don’t shake as I’m too busy gripping the controller from playing countless hours.

author: HardRChoom
quote: I’m a fan of Greek mythology, and this game absolutely nails it on that front. I don’t understand the woke narrative that’s being spouted. Have they seen Aphrodite?? If her hair moves another inch either left or right, top and bottom, this game would have gotten a perfect score!

author: HardRChoom
quote: My first ever Remedy game. I was in awe of the world building and the combat was truly something unique here. Haven’t played Resonant, the sequel to this game, but I just know this game is much better regardless!

author: HardRChoom
quote: It’s great that they added even more robo dinos for me to blow up and scavenge for parts, but this sequel to Zero Dawn is really just polished bloat. And why did they change Aloy’s face? She looks like a chipmunk with nuts stored her cheeks.

author: HardRChoom
quote: They finally gave us the Batmobile to use in game! Is it overused? I don’t know. I’m not over here adding up the percentage of game time between playing as Batman and driving in the Batmobile. If you need more of the dark knight in action, just do the combat challenges.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Disappointed that a game with both Chris and Leon being playable is so lackluster. It’s the Mercenaries mode that gives this game any replay value and it’s also where the gunplay mechanics truly shine.

author: HardRChoom
quote: The Nioh series has always been and always will be superior to Dark Souls. Forget clunky dodge roll nonsense, give me fast and decisive combat! The micromanagement of armor and weapon sets are a non-issue unless you have brain capacity of a sand gnat.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Deep combat mechanics and build variety have returned and it’s great. This is just Ninja Gaiden with a Ki bar! People complained about the mission based structure of the second game but now they complaining about this game’s open world structure. Maybe the clowns should stick to the circus and birthday parties.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Leagues above the first game. Devs made the right choice to get rid of the stamina bar so now combat is more fluid and enjoyable. I also appreciate Proxima being caked up so I have a nice view while I play.

author: HardRChoom
quote: I can’t speak on if these are bad ports but I personally didn’t have any problems with any of the titles. It’s because of this collection that I have a newfound respect for NG3 Razor’s Edge. In fact, the best thing to happen to the third game is that NG4 exists so now it’s not the worst numbered entry.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Vergil. He is the storm that is approaching. He is reclaimer of his name. His family crest is the demon of death. Show him your motivation!

author: HardRChoom
quote: My addiction to this game was stronger than my addiction to Mia Khalifa on repeat. Yes, it’s that good. Also remember that 99% of gamblers quit before they win it big.

author: HardRChoom
quote: This remake of a PS2 game is just simply perfect. As a matter of fact, the quality of life improvements they added have made the original game completely obsolete. That is the power of this game’s maaagic (IYKYK).

author: HardRChoom
quote: This game cured my depression despite in the first opening minutes of the game people were getting Thanos snapped. Music is phenomenal and the turn-based combat is highly engaging. Lune’s bare feet also be activating my primal instincts.

author: HardRChoom
quote: On par with the original game, but also better in some ways. More agency when it comes to aiming and shooting, useless QTEs have been put to pasture, and Ada Wong still gets me bricked up. Second best remake in the franchise, right behind OG Resident Evil on GameCube.

author: HardRChoom
quote: I’m not a FF purist, so this particular title being turned into a hack and slash is not a problem to me. Combat system has good enough utility, but definitely not levels deep like in DMC5 even though it is same combat director. The Kaiju boss battles are spectacles to behold. Majority of side quests (about 90%) are utter trash.

author: HardRChoom
quote: The forced Atreus sections really drags the game down, especially on repeat playthroughs. It is only because of the Draupnir spear that I prefer this combat over 2018 GoW. Also, still no jumping so no air combos. I don’t care for the lore implications. Nerfing OP characters is trash.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Most neutered combat system of the mainline titles. Ryu gets sidelined and only has one weapon (two if including DLC). There’s no excuse for lack of weapons. Went back to play Razor’s Edge.

author: HardRChoom
quote: This is NG 2 Sigma, but with blood. Core combat loop is still visceral and engaging and that’s all I care about in Ninja Gaiden games. Camera is not a problem to me because I don’t have skill issues.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Coming from the first title, this sequel is painfully mid. Less combat agency, and once again they forced MJ missions when the devs knew the players didn’t want those to return. Graphics alone can’t carry games.

author: HardRChoom
quote: I never played the older Onimusha titles, but that doesn’t matter as WotS is clearly meant to be a sort of reboot. Combat loop in this game is so satisfying that I actually hated winning so much. One of Capcom’s finest.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Combat in Sekiro does scratch that particular  itch in my brain, especially when it comes to the parry sounds. Very difficult early on but once you get the core loop down, it’s easy peazy lemon squeezy. This is FromSoft’s peak and it’s not even a soulslike!

author: HardRChoom
quote: Wukong is just a boss gauntlet mode turned into an entire game. And honestly, this formula works. Combat does lack a bit of that “oomph” when it comes to hitting the enemies, but it’s still serviceable and can be broken, and I mean in a good way.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Definition of a masterpiece. Gameplay loop so godly I stuck around for the story. Once in a generation type of game.
game_title: NieR: Automata - Game of the YoRHa Edition

author: HardRChoom
quote: I’m aware this is a spin-off of the Yakuza games. With that said, it still has the best combat out of the entire franchise. RGG peaked with this game.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Imagine hating on a game because it has too much content. We have a game in the modern generation that overdelivers in every aspect and we still get people seething and moaning. If you don’t like the remakes, go play the original. It’s that easy.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Giving perfect score because despite the hate and controversy, the studio got the green light to make a sequel. I hope they remove the stamina bar entirely and make the combat more Phantom Blade Zero adjacent.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Stellar Blade has the kind of fan service that would make a normie screech at the top of their lungs because they can’t handle God’s greatest gift to mankind; jiggle physics. Combat is cool too. This game is as much of a soulslike as Sekiro is, which is not at all. So is this game difficult? It was for me but I was playing with one hand whole time so my answer is subjective.

author: HardRChoom
quote: Developers had a direction for this game, and they clearly delivered. Combat is the best it’s ever been in the action game genre, and I’ve played the likes Ninja Gaiden 2 and Devil May Cry 5. And yes, this game is also better than Sekiro.
